name: attention
description: Attention sensors — hook-only L1 plugin pushing operator notifications from Claude Code lifecycle hooks into the runtime notification emitter (ADR-0040 §3). Registers Notification (permission_prompt → approval/urgent, idle_prompt → idle), Stop (workflow-terminal behind a freshness-checked session-handoff projection read, else bare turn-complete), and SubagentStop (subagent-complete). Hooks + sensor scripts only: no skills, no verbs, no state machinery. Sensors are fail-closed silent observers (exit 0 always, never stdout, no decision output) that resolve the runtime plugin root via a version-gated discover-runtime ladder (>= 0.71.0, the first runtime release shipping notify.mjs) and shell out to notify.mjs emit; notifications stay off until the operator sets a notify_channel via runtime:settings.
